paragraphs: Zurn Elkay Water Solutions Corporation ("Zurn Elkay", "we", "us", "our", or the "Company") is a growth-oriented, pure-play water management business that designs, procures, manufactures, and markets what we believe to be the broadest sustainable product portfolio of specification-driven water management solutions to improve health, hydration, human safety and the environment. Our product portfolio includes professional grade water safety and control products, flow systems products, hygienic and environmental products, and filtered drinking water products for public and private spaces that deliver superior value to building owners, positively impact the environment and human hygiene and reduce product installation time. Our heritage of innovation and specification has allowed us to provide highly-engineered, mission-critical solutions to customers for decades and affords us the privilege of having long-term, valued relationships with market leaders. We operate in a disciplined way and the Zurn Elkay Business System ("ZEBS"), described below, is our operating philosophy. Grounded in the spirit of continuous improvement, ZEBS creates a scalable, process-based framework that focuses on driving superior customer satisfaction and financial results by targeting world-class operating performance throughout all aspects of our business.

Zurn Elkay is a leading provider of specification-driven water management solutions to the multi-billion dollar construction market of primarily institutional and commercial buildings and to a lesser extent to the waterworks and residential construction markets.

Our strategy is to build Zurn Elkay around a strategic platform that participates in end markets with sustainable growth characteristics where we are, or have the opportunity to become, the industry leader. We have a track record of acquiring and integrating companies and expect to continue to pursue strategic acquisitions that will broaden our product lines, allow us to move into adjacent markets and expand our geographic presence.

The demand for our products is primarily driven by new institutional and commercial building construction, the retrofit of existing structures (to make them more energy and water efficient) and, to a lesser extent, new infrastructure and residential construction. With our broad portfolio of products, we believe we have become a market leader in the industry by developing innovative products that meet stringent third-party regulatory, building, and plumbing code requirements and by subsequently achieving specification of our products into projects and applications.

We are led by an experienced, high-caliber management team that employs ZEBS as a proven operating philosophy to drive excellence and world-class performance in all aspects of our business, which includes our "Voice of the Customer" process to promote superior customer satisfaction and striving for continuous improvement across the business. Our physical footprint encompasses 21 principal manufacturing and warehouse facilities located primarily in North America.

As previously disclosed, on February 12, 2022, Zurn Water Solutions Corporation entered into a definitive agreement to combine with Elkay Manufacturing Company (the "Merger" or "Elkay Merger"). On July 1, 2022, the Merger was completed following which we changed our name to "Zurn Elkay Water Solutions Corporation". Shares of our common stock are traded on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol "ZWS".

Also, as previously disclosed, on October 4, 2021, we completed a Reverse Morris Trust tax-free spin-off transaction (the "Spin-Off Transaction") in which our former Process & Motion Control business was divested to Regal Rexnord Corporation (formerly known as Regal Beloit Corporation). Following the transaction, we operate as a pure-play water management business. The operating results and financial position of the Process & Motion Control business are reported as discontinued operations within our consolidated financial statements.

ZEBS creates a scalable, process-based framework that focuses on driving superior customer satisfaction and financial results by targeting world-class operating performance throughout all aspects of our business. ZEBS is based on the following principles: (1) strategy deployment (a long-term strategic planning process that determines annual improvement priorities and the actions necessary to achieve those priorities); (2) measuring our performance based on customer satisfaction, or the "Voice of the Customer;" (3) involvement of all our associates in the execution of our strategy; and (4) a culture that embraces Kaizen, the Japanese philosophy of continuous improvement and the concepts around 80/20 simplification. We believe applying ZEBS can yield superior growth, quality, delivery and operating costs relative to our competition, resulting in enhanced profitability and ultimately the creation of stockholder value. As we continue to apply ZEBS, we have experienced improvements in growth, productivity, cost reduction and asset efficiency and believe there are ongoing opportunities to improve our performance.

Zurn Elkay is a growth-oriented, pure-play water management business that designs, procures, manufactures, and markets what we believe to be the broadest sustainable product portfolio of specification-driven water management solutions to improve health, hydration, human safety and the environment. Our product portfolio includes professional grade water safety and control products, flow systems products, hygienic and environmental products, and filtered drinking water products for public and private spaces that deliver superior value to building owners, positively impact the environment and human hygiene and reduce product installation time. Our products are marketed and sold under widely recognized brand names, including Zurn®, Elkay®, Wilkins®, Green Turtle®, World Dryer®, StainlessDrains.com™, JUST®, Hadrian®, Wade®, and Halsey Taylor®.

Over the past century, Zurn Elkay has established itself as an innovator and leading designer, manufacturer and distributor of highly engineered products and solutions that control the flow, delivery, treatment and conservation of water as well as human hygiene to and within institutional and commercial buildings and, to a lesser extent, for waterworks and residential applications. The institutional construction end users include education, healthcare, and government segments. The commercial construction end users include retail, office, lodging, dining, warehouse, and sports arenas segments. The waterworks end users include municipal water and wastewater and transportation segments. The demand for our products is primarily driven by new institutional and commercial building construction, the retrofit of existing structures (to make them more energy and water efficient) and, to a lesser extent, new waterworks and residential construction.

Our products are principally specification-driven given their technical design and ability to meet certain performance characteristics. They deliver superior value to building owners, positively impact the environment and human health and hygiene and reduce product installation time while meeting the stringent county-specific regulatory, building, and plumbing code requirements. These stringent testing and regulatory approval processes are completed principally through the Foundation for Cross-Connection Control and Hydraulic Research at the University of Southern California ("USC"), the International Association of Plumbing and Mechanical Officials ("IAPMO"), the National Sanitation Foundation ("NSF"), the American National Standards Institute ("ANSI"), ASTM International ("ASTM"), the Plumbing and Drainage Institute ("PDI"), Underwriters Laboratories ("UL"), Factory Mutual ("FM") and the American Waterworks Association ("AWWA") typically prior to the commercialization of our products. Our products are project-critical and typically represent a low percentage of the overall project cost. We believe these characteristics, coupled with our extensive distribution network, create a high level of end-user loyalty for our products and allow us to achieve specification of our products into projects and applications and to maintain leading market shares in the majority of our product lines.

We utilize an extensive sales and marketing network with a strong focus on the North American market. This market consists of approximately 1,000 independent sales representatives across 120 sales agencies in North America. Specifically, it has been our experience that, once an architect, engineer, contractor, or owner has specified our product with satisfactory results, that person will generally continue to use our products in future projects. The inclusion of our products in project specifications, combined with our ability to innovate, engineer, and deliver products and systems that save time and money in both installation and over the life of the product for engineers, architects, contractors and builders has resulted in growing demand for our products. Our distribution model is predicated upon maintaining high product availability near our customers. We believe this model provides us with a competitive advantage as we can meet our customer demand with local inventory at significantly reduced lead times as compared with others in our industry.

We evaluate our competitive position in our markets based on available market data, relevant benchmarks compared to our relative peer group and industry trends. We generally do not participate in segments of our served markets that have been commoditized or in applications that do not require differentiation based on product quality, reliability and innovation. We serve a broad and diverse array of institutional and commercial end markets, and to a lesser extent waterworks and residential end markets, with solid fundamental long-term growth characteristics. We believe there continues to be long-term growth potential in our markets.

The markets in which we participate are relatively fragmented with competitors across a broad range of industries, sectors, and product lines. Although competition exists across all of our businesses, we do not believe that any one competitor directly competes with us across the breadth of all of our product lines. We believe our served markets are growing long term at relatively strong rates, and that the growing demand for water safety, conservation, hygienic solutions, availability of clean drinking water, and the elimination of plastic water bottles can potentially support market growth above that of overall United States industrial production. We believe that we can continue to grow our platform long term at rates above the growth rate of the overall market and the growth rate of our competition, by focusing our efforts and resources towards end markets that have above-average growth characteristics.

headings: Economic and financial market weakness, as well as overall challenging market cycles, may particularly impact the markets we serve, and, as a result may adversely affect our financial condition or results of operations.
The markets we serve are highly competitive; an inability to effectively compete would adversely affect our business, financial condition and results of operations.
The loss or financial instability of any significant customer or customers accounting for our backlog could adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations or cash flows.
The inability to adequately protect intellectual property, or defend against infringement claims brought against us, could adversely affect our business.
Our inability to attract and retain key personnel, as well as challenges with respect to the management of human capital resources, in a highly competitive industry may adversely affect our business.
Increased frequency of weather events could disrupt construction activity and adversely affect the demand for our products.
The long-term effect of climate change could decrease demand for certain of our products.
The physical impacts of climate change may materially adversely affect our business and financial condition.
Our business and operations, and the operations of our suppliers, business partners and customers, may be adversely affected by future outbreaks of infectious diseases.
Artificial intelligence presents challenges that can impact our business by posing security risks to confidential or proprietary information and personal data.
Our goodwill and intangible assets are valued at an amount that is high relative to our total assets and in excess of our stockholders' equity.
Regulatory and legislative developments related to climate change, may materially adversely affect our business and financial condition.
We are subject to changes in legislative, regulatory and legal developments involving taxes.
We may incur significant costs for environmental compliance and/or to address liabilities under environmental laws and regulations, and our reputation may be adversely affected.

Certain subsidiaries are subject to litigation, including product liability and other claims, which could adversely affect our business, reputation, financial condition, results of operations or cash flows.
Our inability to achieve our sustainability strategy goals and targets could adversely impact our business, financial condition, results of operations or cash flows.
paragraphs: The risks described below are not the only risks facing Zurn Elkay. Additional risks and uncertainties not currently known to us, or those risks we currently view to be immaterial, may also materially and adversely affect our business, financial condition or results of operations. In addition, see Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations in Item 7 for further discussion of some of the factors that could affect future results. If any of these risks materialize, our business, financial condition, results of operations or cash flows could be materially and adversely affected.

Our business operations may be adversely affected by volatility and weaknesses in the overall economy and financial markets. Weak, challenging or volatile economic conditions in the end markets, businesses or geographic areas in which we sell our products typically reduces demand for our products and results in a decrease in sales volume.

Our financial performance depends, in large part, on conditions in the markets that we serve in the U.S. and, to a lesser extent, the global economy generally. Some of the end markets we serve are highly cyclical, and some at times have experienced greater cyclicality than others. Any sustained weakness in demand or downturn or uncertainty in the economy, could materially reduce our net sales and profitability.

For example, sales to the construction industry are driven by trends in institutional, commercial, and residential construction, housing starts and trends in residential repair and remodeling. Consumer confidence, employment rates, weather conditions, interest rates, credit standards and availability of consumer credit and income levels play a significant role in driving demand in institutional, commercial and residential construction, repair and remodeling sectors. A drop or weakness in consumer confidence, prolonged adverse weather conditions, lack of availability or increased cost of credit, tightened credit standards or increased unemployment could materially impact demand for sales of our products and/or result in downward pressure on product pricing and our profit margins, any or all of which could adversely affect our financial results.

Volatility and disruption of financial markets could limit the ability of our customers to obtain adequate financing to maintain operations and may cause them to terminate existing purchase orders, reduce the volume of products they purchase from us in the future or impact their ability to pay their receivables. Adverse economic and financial market conditions may also cause our suppliers to be unable to meet their commitments to us or may cause suppliers to make changes in the credit terms they extend to us, such as shortening the required payment period for outstanding accounts receivable or reducing or eliminating the amount of trade credit available to us.

We operate in highly competitive markets. Some of our competitors have achieved substantially more market penetration in certain of the markets in which we operate. Some of our competitors are larger and may have greater financial and other resources than we do, and our competitors may adopt more aggressive sales policies and devote greater resources to the development, promotion and sale of their products than we do, all of which could result in a loss of customers and adversely affect our results of operations.

paragraphs: We completed the spin-off of our Process & Motion Control platform ("PMC") on October 4, 2021 in the Spin-Off Transaction, and, accordingly, the results of operations and financial condition associated with PMC have been reclassified to discontinued operations for all periods presented. As a result, the following discussion of results of operations and financial condition is centered on the Zurn Elkay Water Solutions business excluding PMC. The consolidated statements of cash flows for the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024, and 2023 have not been adjusted to separately disclose cash flows related to the discontinued operations. See Item 8, Note 3, Discontinued Operations for additional information on discontinued operations.

This discussion contains forward-looking statements and involves numerous risks and uncertainties, including, but not limited to, those described in the "Risk Factors" in Item 1A of this report. Actual results may differ materially from those contained in any forward-looking statements. See also "Cautionary Notice Regarding Forward-Looking Statements" found elsewhere in this report.

The information contained in this section is provided as a supplement to the consolidated financial statements and the related notes included elsewhere in this report to help provide an understanding of our financial condition, changes in our financial condition and results of our operations. This section is organized as follows:
Company Overview. This section provides a general description of our business.

Financial Statement Presentation. This section provides a brief description of certain items and accounting policies that appear in our financial statements and general factors that impact these items.

Critical Accounting Estimates. This section discusses the accounting policies and estimates that we consider to be important to our financial condition and results of operations and that require significant judgment and estimates by management in their application.

Recent Accounting Pronouncements. This section cites the discussion of new or revised accounting pronouncements and standards in Item 8, Note 2, Significant Accounting Policies of our consolidated financial statements.
Overview of Recent Developments. This section provides a description of the recent events impacting our results of operations.

Results of Operations. This section provides an analysis of our results of operations. In providing analysis of the results of our operations, we have provided a comparison of our year ended December 31, 2025 to the year ended December 31, 2024. A discussion of the financial performance for the year ended December 31, 2024 compared to December 31, 2023 can be found within "Item 7. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations" of our 2024 Form 10-K.
Non-GAAP Financial Measures. This section provides an explanation of certain financial measures we use that are not in accordance with U.S. generally accepted accounting principles ("GAAP").
Covenant Compliance. This section provides a discussion of certain restrictive covenants in our credit agreement.

Liquidity and Capital Resources. This section provides an analysis of our cash flows and year-to-year comparisons for our years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024, as well as a discussion of our indebtedness and its potential effects on our liquidity. A discussion of cash flows for the year ended December 31, 2024 compared to December 31, 2023 can be found within "Item 7. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations" of our 2024 Form 10-K.
Contractual Obligations. This section provides a discussion of our commitments as of December 31, 2025.
Quantitative and Qualitative Disclosures about Market Risk. This section discusses our exposure to potential losses arising from adverse changes in interest rates and foreign exchange rates.

Zurn Elkay Water Solutions Corporation ("Zurn Elkay", "we", "us", "our", or the "Company") 為一成長導向、純水管理業務，設計、採購、製造與行銷我們認為為目前最廣泛的永續性產品組合，以符合規格的水管理解決方案改善健康、水分補給、人類安全與環境。我們的產品組合包括專業等級的水安全與控制產品、流量系統產品、衛生與環境產品，以及用於公共與私人空間的過濾飲用水產品，為建築物所有者提供優越價值，正面影響環境與人類衛生，並減少產品安裝時間。我們的創新與規格遺產使我們能為客戶提供高度工程化的關鍵任務解決方案數十年，並享有與市場領導者建立長期、受重視的關係的榮幸。我們以嚴謹的方式運作，Zurn Elkay 商業系統 ("ZEBS")，如下所述，為我們的運作哲學。ZEBS 基於持續改進的精神，建立一個可擴展、以流程為基礎的架構，專注於透過在所有業務層面追求世界級運營表現，來驅動優越的客戶滿意度與財務成果。
Zurn Elkay 為主要機構與商業建築的多十億美元建設市場，以及較少程度的水工與住宅建設市場，提供以規格為導向的水管理解決方案。
我們的策略是將 Zurn Elkay 建立在一個戰略平台之上，參與具可持續成長特徵的終端市場，我們或是有機會成為產業領導者。我們有收購與整合公司的紀錄，並預期會持續追求戰略收購，以拓展我們的產品線，使我們能進入相鄰市場，並擴大我們的地理存在。
我們產品的需求主要由新的機構與商業建築建設、現有結構的翻新（使其更節能與節水）以及較少程度的新基礎建設與住宅建設所驅動。憑藉我們廣泛的產品組合，我們相信我們已成為產業的市場領導者，透過開發符合嚴格第三方規範、建築與水管法規要求的創新產品，並隨後將我們的產品指定為專案與應用的解決方案。
我們由經驗豐富、高素質的管理團隊領導，運用 ZENB 作為已證實的運作哲學，以驅動我們業務所有層面的卓越與世界級表現，包括我們的 "客戶聲音" 流程，以促進優越的客戶滿意度，並追求業務各方面的持續改進。我們的實體設施包括 21 個主要的製造與倉庫設施，主要位於北美地區。

如前所披露，於 2022 年 2 月 12 日，Zurn Water Solutions Corporation 與 Elkay Manufacturing Company（"合併" 或 "Elkay 合併"）簽訂了最終協議。於 2022 年 7 月 1 日，合併完成後，我們將公司名稱更為 "Zurn Elkay Water Solutions Corporation"。我們的普通股於紐約證券交易所交易，股票代碼為 "ZWS"。

此外，如前所披露，於 2021 年 10 月 4 日，我們完成了無稅的反向莫里斯信託分拆交易（"分拆交易"），將我們的前 Process & Motion Control 事業部門出售給 Regal Rexnord Corporation（原為 Regal Beloit Corporation）。交易後，我們作為一純水管理業務運作。Process & Motion Control 事業部門的營運成果與財務狀況於我們的合併財務報表中列為已終止營運。

ZEBS 建立了一個可擴展、以流程為基礎的架構，專注於透過在所有業務層面追求世界級運營表現，來驅動優越的客戶滿意度與財務成果。ZEBS 基於以下原則：(1) 策略部署（一項長期戰略規劃流程，以確定年度改進優先順序與實現這些優先順序所需的行動）；(2) 以客戶滿意度衡量我們的表現，或稱為 "客戶聲音"；(3) 所有員工參與我們策略的執行；以及 (4) 一種擁抱 Kaizen 的文化，這是一種日本持續改進的哲學與 80/20 簡化概念。我們相信應用 ZEBS 可以相對於競爭對手，帶來優越的成長、品質、交付與運營成本，進而提高利潤率，最終創造股東價值。隨著我們持續應用 ZEBS，我們已體驗到成長、生產力、成本降低與資產效率的改善，並相信仍有持續改善我們表現的機會。

Zurn Elkay 是一家以成長為導向、純粹從事水管理業務的公司，設計、採購、製造與行銷我們認為是目前最廣泛的永續產品組合，提供以規格為導向的水管理解決方案，以改善健康、水分補給、人類安全與環境。我們的產品組合包括專業等級的水安全與控制產品、流量系統產品、衛生與環境產品，以及用於公私場所的過濾飲用水產品，為大樓所有者提供優越價值，正面影響環境與人類衛生，並減少產品安裝時間。我們的產品以廣為認知的品牌名稱行銷與銷售，包括 Zurn®、Elkay®、Wilkins®、Green Turtle®、World Dryer®、StainlessDrains.com™、JUST®、Hadrian®、Wade® 和 Halsey Taylor®。

在過去一個世紀，Zurn Elkay 已建立為創新者與領先的設計、製造與分銷高工程化產品與解決方案的公司，這些產品與解決方案用以控制水的流動、配送、處理與節約，以及機構與商業大樓內的人類衛生，並在較小程度上用於水工與住宅應用。機構建設的最終用戶包括教育、醫療與政府部門。商業建設的最終用戶包括零售、辦公室、旅館、餐飲、倉庫與體育場館部門。水工的最終用戶包括市立水與廢水處理與交通部門。我們產品的需求主要由新的機構與商業大樓建設、現有建築物的翻新（以提高能源與用水效率）以及較小程度的新水工與住宅建設所驅動。

我們的產品主要以規格為導向，這是因為其技術設計與能達到特定性能特徵的能耐。這些產品為大樓所有者提供優越價值，正面影響環境與人類健康與衛生，並減少產品安裝時間，同時符合嚴格的縣級特定法規、建築與水管法規要求。這些嚴格的測試與法規核准程序主要透過南加州大學（"USC"）的跨連接控制與水力研究基金會、國際水管與機械官員協會（"IAPMO"）、國家衛生基金會（"NSF"）、美國國家標準協會（"ANSI"）、ASTM 國際（"ASTM"）、水管與排水協會（"PDI"）、Underwriters Laboratories（"UL"）、Factory Mutual（"FM"）與美國水工協會（"AWWA"）在產品商業化前完成。我們的產品為項目關鍵性產品，通常代表整體項目成本的低比例。我們認為這些特徵，加上我們廣泛的分銷網路，創造了高程度的最終用戶忠誠度，使我們能將產品指定至項目與應用，並在我們產品線的大多數領域維持領先市場佔有率。

我們使用廣泛的銷售與行銷網路，並強調北美市場。這個市場包括約 1,000 名獨立銷售代表，分佈在北美 120 個銷售機構。我們的經驗顯示，一旦建築師、工程師、承包商或所有者以滿意的結果指定我們的產品，該人通常會在未來的項目中繼續使用我們的產品。產品被納入項目規格，加上我們能創新、設計與交付能節省安裝時間與產品壽命中成本的產品與系統，使工程師、建築師、承包商與建造商產生日益增長的需求。我們的分銷模式以維持高產品可得性於客戶附近為基礎。我們認為此模式為我們提供競爭優勢，因為我們能以遠低於業界其他公司的庫存前置時間，滿足客戶需求。
我們根據可取得的市場數據、與我們相對產業同業的相關指標與產業趨勢來評估我們在市場中的競爭地位。我們通常不參與已被商品化的市場部分，或不需根據產品品質、可靠性與創新來區分的應用。我們服務廣泛且多樣化的機構與商業最終市場，並在較小程度上服務水工與住宅最終市場，這些市場具有堅實的長期成長特徵。我們認為我們的市場仍有長期成長潛力。

我們參與的市場相對分散，競爭者來自廣泛的產業、部門與產品線。雖然競爭存在於我們所有業務中，我們不認為有任何一個競爭者能跨所有產品線與我們直接競爭。我們認為我們服務的市場長期以相對強勁的成長率成長，且對水安全、節水、衛生解決方案、潔淨飲用水的可得性以及消除塑膠水瓶的需求，可能支持市場成長超過美國整體工業生產的成長。我們認為我們能透過專注於具有高於平均成長特徵的最終市場，持續在長遠成長率上超越整體市場與競爭對手的成長率。

paragraphs: 我們於2021年10月4日完成將Process & Motion Control平台（"PMC"）分拆的交易（"Spin-Off Transaction"），因此，與PMC相關的營運結果與財務狀況已重新歸類為已終止營運，適用於所有呈列期間。因此，以下對營運結果與財務狀況的討論，係以Zurn Elkay Water Solutions業務為主，排除PMC。2025年、2024年及2023年12月31日止的合併現金流量表，尚未調整以分開披露與已終止營運相關的現金流量。有關已終止營運的更多資訊，請參閱第8項，附註3，已終止營運。
本討論包含前瞻性聲明，並涉及許多風險與不確定性，包括但不限於本報告第1A項"風險因素"中所描述的風險。實際結果可能與任何前瞻性聲明中所載內容有重大差異。請參閱本報告其他部分的"對前瞻性聲明的警示說明"。
本節所含資訊係作為合併財務報表及相關附註的補充，以協助瞭解本公司財務狀況、財務狀況的變動及營運結果。本節內容組織如下：
公司概況。本節提供本公司業務的一般描述。
財務報表呈現。本節提供財務報表中某些項目及會計政策的簡要說明，以及影響這些項目的一般因素。
關鍵會計估計。本節討論我們認為對財務狀況及營運結果重要，且需經管理階層做出重大判斷及估計的會計政策與估計。
近期會計準則聲明。本節引用新或修正會計準則及標準的討論，請參閱第8項，附註2，合併財務報表的重大會計政策。
近期發展概述。本節提供影響營運結果的近期事件描述。
營運成果。本節提供對本公司營運成果的分析。在提供營運成果分析時，本公司已提供2025年12月31日財務年度與2024年12月31日財務年度的比較。2024年12月31日財務年度與2023年12月31日財務年度的財務表現比較討論，可於本公司2024年Form 10-K的「第7項 管理層對財務狀況與營運成果之討論與分析」中找到。
非GAAP財務指標。本節說明本公司使用之某些財務指標，這些指標並未依照美國通用會計準則（"GAAP"）。
契約遵守。本節提供對本公司信貸協議中某些限制性契約條款的討論。
流動性與資本資源。本節提供對本公司現金流量及年度間比較的分析，以及對2025年12月31日財務年度與2024年12月31日財務年度的討論，並說明本公司負債及其對流動性潛在影響。2024年12月31日財務年度與2023年12月31日財務年度的現金流量比較討論，可於本公司2024年Form 10-K的「第7項 管理層對財務狀況與營運成果之討論與分析」中找到。
契約義務。本節提供對本公司截至2025年12月31日之承諾事項的討論。
市場風險之量化與質化揭露。本節討論本公司因利率與外匯匯率不利變動而可能產生之潛在損失風險。

headings: 經濟與金融市場的疲軟，以及總體經濟挑戰性的市場週期，可能特別影響我們所服務的市場，並因此可能不利於我們的財務狀況或營運成果。
我們所服務的市場競爭激烈；若無法有效競爭，將不利於我們的業務、財務狀況、營運成果。
任何重要客戶或客戶羣體的流失或財務不穩定，可能影響我們的業務、財務狀況、營運成果或現金流。
無法充分保護智慧財產權，或無法對抗針對我們提出的侵權聲索，可能不利於我們的業務。
我們無法吸引並留住關鍵人才，以及在高度競爭的產業中管理人力資源的困難，可能不利於我們的業務。
氣候變遷導致天氣事件發生頻率增加，可能幹擾建設活動，並不利於我們產品的需求
氣候變遷的長期影響可能降低我們某些產品的需求。
氣候變遷的實體影響可能對我們的業務與財務狀況造成重大不利影響。
我們的業務與運作，以及我們供應商、商業夥伴與客戶的運作，可能因未來傳染病的爆發而受到不利影響。
人工智慧帶來的挑戰可能透過對機密或專屬資訊及個人資料的安全風險，影響我們的業務。
我們的商譽與無形資產價值相對於我們的總資產而言偏高，且超過我們股東權益。
與氣候變遷相關的法規與立法發展，可能對我們的業務與財務狀況造成重大不利影響。
本公司受立法、法規及法律變動涉及稅務之影響。
本公司可能因環境法規遵循及/或處理環境法規下的責任而產生重大成本，且本公司聲譽可能受到不利影響。
部分子公司涉及訴訟，包括產品責任及其他聲請，此等訴訟可能對本公司業務、聲譽、財務狀況、營運成果或現金流造成不利影響。
本公司無法達成永續發展策略目標及指標，可能對本公司業務、財務狀況、營運成果或現金流造成不利影響。
paragraphs: 下列所描述的風險並非本公司唯一面臨的風險。尚有其他風險與不確定性，目前尚未為本公司所知悉，或目前認為不重要，但這些風險仍可能對本公司業務、財務狀況或營運成果造成重大且不利的影響。此外，請參閱第7項「管理層對財務狀況與營運成果之討論與分析」，以進一步瞭解可能影響未來結果的一些因素。若任何上述風險實現，本公司業務、財務狀況、營運成果或現金流可能受到重大且不利的影響。
本公司業務運作可能因總體經濟與金融市場的波動與不穩定而受到不利影響。我們銷售產品的終端市場、企業或地理區域若出現弱勢、挑戰性或波動性的經濟條件，通常會降低對我們產品的需求，並導致銷售量減少。
本公司財務表現在很大程度上取決於我們服務的美國市場狀況，以及較小程度的全球總體經濟。我們服務的一些終端市場具有高度週期性，有時甚至比其他市場更具週期性。若需求持續疲軟或經濟出現衰退或不確定性，可能會對我們的淨銷售額與獲利能力造成重大影響。

例如，建設產業的銷售受到機構、商業與住宅建設趨勢、住宅開工數與住宅修繕與裝修趨勢的影響。消費者信心、就業率、天氣條件、利率、信貸標準與消費者信貸的可取得性以及收入水平，在機構、商業與住宅建設、修繕與裝修領域中，對需求有顯著影響。消費者信心下降、持續不利的天氣條件、信貸取得困難或成本上升、信貸標準趨嚴或失業率上升，可能會對我們產品的銷售需求造成重大影響，或導致產品價格下修與我們的毛利率受到壓力，任何或全部這些情況都可能對我們的財務結果造成不利影響。
金融市場的波動與中斷可能限制我們客戶取得足夠融資以維持營運的能力，並可能導致他們終止現有的採購訂單、減少未來從我們處購買產品的數量，或影響他們支付應收款項的能力。不利的經濟與金融市場條件也可能導致我們的供應商無法履行對我們的承諾，或導致供應商改變對我們提供的信用條款，例如縮短應收款項的付款期限，或減少或取消對我們的貿易信貸。
我們所處的是高度競爭的市場。我們的一些競爭對手在某些我們經營的市場中已取得顯著更高的市場佔有率。一些競爭對手規模較大，可能擁有比我們更多的財務及其他資源，且他們可能採用更具侵略性的銷售政策，並投入更多資源於產品的開發、推廣與銷售，所有這些都可能導致客戶流失，並對我們的營運成果造成不利影響。
